key_findings: 22.45B XRP across 701 attributed wallets and 24 exchanges at 2026-11-01 08:00 UTC; same-wallet changes -161.1M over seven days but only -12.7M over 30 days. This is custody inventory, not tradable float.
Upbit 6.43B, Coinbase 5.85B and Binance 2.78B represent about 67.1% of the tracked exchange-wallet total.

487.9M XRP in tracked exchange-controlled reserves/funds includes 325.8M Binance-Peg backing, 150.9M cbXRP backing and 11.2M insurance/charity. Coinbase cbXRP backing is also counted in the DeFi category; avoid double counting.
ETF/index funds held about 1.20B XRP and $1.51B net assets; weekly unit flow +3.39M XRP for Oct26-30, while Oct30 was -49.9K XRP. GXRP flow gap remains.
Kodexius reports $759.93M open interest across seven contracts and +0.0055% funding at 11:27 UTC. Liqwall reported $1.33B OI at 03:52 UTC. Coverage differs; no OI trend is inferred.
XRP Radar reports about $707M RLUSD supply on XRPL and $2.42B total across XRPL/Ethereum; this is a secondary onchain aggregation snapshot.
XRPL transactions burn XRP fees, but the standard minimum 10-drop fee is tiny and not proportional to stablecoin transfer value.
RWA represented registry notional of $4.06B is not freely transferable collateral; distributed transferable value is reported at $276M and some asset values are stale.
